desc: 宽松落肩上衣配弹力腰中裤，胸前图位点睛，穿脱方便显精神
name: 女童印花运动两件套轻盈款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示两件套全貌
一秒传达宽松舒适的核心利益，承接主图点击
放大普通裤腰勒肚子、面料闷热的穿着痛点
让家长代入孩子日常外穿与居家活动的真实场景
用面料纹理微距证明亲肤透气与做工质感
以结构化规格版式消除尺码与参数疑虑，数值留待填充
并列展示两个配色，帮买家快速做出选择
用洗护图标与留空凭证位降低决策风险
收口促单，以组合呈现与行动按钮完成转化

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant grid, cream beige #FBF3DC and warm white #FAF8F4 for info and trust screens, one mango-yellow #F2B705 accent panel for the closing shot
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single charcoal color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent vibrant kids-sportswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm white #FAF8F4, cream beige #FBF3DC, mango yellow accent #F2B705, charcoal ink text #222222 and one woven-stripe red #C63A2F; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end kidswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the two-piece set across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale-grey board #EDEBE7 and light wood-plank home flooring
